The live application below is running completely client-side in your browser using serverless **Shinylive** (WebAssembly). You can interactively step through simulation events (+1, +10, +100 steps), toggle species visibility (`Host`, `Parasite`), switch between **Overlay (1 Map)** and **Separate (Adjacent Maps)** view modes, and inspect organism positions on hexagonal substrate overlays.

```{r, echo=FALSE, results='asis'}
inc_files <- c("R/inputApp.R", "R/substrateApp.R", "R/ewing_substrate.R", "R/substrate_triangle.R", "R/hexmoveApp.R")

cat("```{shinylive-r}\n")
cat("#| standalone: true\n")
cat("#| viewerHeight: 850\n")
cat("#| components: [viewer]\n\n")

cat("library(shiny)\n")
cat("library(bslib)\n")
cat("library(ggplot2)\n")
cat("library(cowplot)\n")
cat("library(stats)\n\n")

cat("# --- Standalone Simulation Adapters for webR ---\n\n")

cat('record_history <- function(sim) {
  t_val <- sim$step
  df_list <- list()
  for (sp in names(sim$pop)) {
    org <- sim$pop[[sp]]$org
    stg <- org["stage", ]
    pch <- sim$pop[[sp]]$pch
    for (s_idx in seq_along(pch)) {
      stg_name <- pch[s_idx]
      cnt <- sum(stg + 1 == s_idx)
      df_list[[length(df_list) + 1]] <- data.frame(time = t_val, Species = sp, State = stg_name, Count = cnt, Type = "ageclass", stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
    }
    df_list[[length(df_list) + 1]] <- data.frame(time = t_val, Species = sp, State = "total", Count = ncol(org), Type = "ageclass", stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  }
  hist_new <- do.call(rbind, df_list)
  sim$history <- rbind(sim$history, hist_new)
  sim
}

make_sim_community <- function(nhost = 200, nparasite = 200) {
  sub_names <- c("fr1", "fr2", "fr3", "fr4", "twig", "lftop", "lfbot")
  h_stages <- sample(0:6, nhost, replace = TRUE, prob = c(0.4, 0.2, 0.15, 0.1, 0.08, 0.05, 0.02))
  h_subs <- sample(1:7, nhost, replace = TRUE, prob = c(0.15, 0.1, 0.1, 0.1, 0.1, 0.4, 0.05))
  h_pa <- runif(nhost, -80, 80); h_pb <- runif(nhost, -80, 80); h_pc <- -(h_pa + h_pb)
  p_stages <- sample(1:5, nparasite, replace = TRUE, prob = c(0.35, 0.25, 0.2, 0.1, 0.1))
  p_subs <- sample(1:7, nparasite, replace = TRUE, prob = c(0.1, 0.1, 0.1, 0.15, 0.1, 0.4, 0.05))
  p_pa <- runif(nparasite, -80, 80); p_pb <- runif(nparasite, -80, 80); p_pc <- -(p_pa + p_pb)
  h_mat <- rbind(pos.a = h_pa, pos.b = h_pb, pos.c = h_pc, stage = h_stages, sub.stage = h_subs)
  p_mat <- rbind(pos.a = p_pa, pos.b = p_pb, pos.c = p_pc, stage = p_stages, sub.stage = p_subs)
  h_pch <- c("0", "1", "2", "3", "4", "5", "V"); h_col <- c("brown", "green", "turquoise", "blue", "violet", "purple", "magenta")
  p_pch <- c("E", "L", "p", "P", "F"); p_col <- c("brown", "green", "turquoise", "blue", "orange")
  sim <- list(step = 0, pop = list(host = list(org = h_mat, pch = h_pch, col = h_col), parasite = list(org = p_mat, pch = p_pch, col = p_col)), sub_names = sub_names, history = data.frame())
  sim <- record_history(sim)
  class(sim) <- c("ewing", "list")
  sim
}

step_sim_community <- function(sim, nstep = 50) {
  sub_interval <- if (nstep <= 5) 1 else if (nstep <= 20) 2 else if (nstep <= 100) 5 else if (nstep <= 500) 25 else 50
  sub_steps <- seq(sub_interval, nstep, by = sub_interval)
  if (length(sub_steps) == 0 || tail(sub_steps, 1) != nstep) sub_steps <- c(sub_steps, nstep)
  last_step <- 0
  for (s_inc in sub_steps) {
    inc <- s_inc - last_step
    last_step <- s_inc
    sim$step <- sim$step + inc
    for (sp in names(sim$pop)) {
      org <- sim$pop[[sp]]$org
      n <- ncol(org)
      stg <- org["stage", ]
      stg <- pmin(stg + sample(0:1, n, replace = TRUE, prob = c(0.85, 0.15)), 6)
      org["stage", ] <- stg
      org["pos.a", ] <- org["pos.a", ] + runif(n, -10, 10)
      org["pos.b", ] <- org["pos.b", ] + runif(n, -10, 10)
      org["pos.c", ] <- -(org["pos.a", ] + org["pos.b", ])
      switch_idx <- sample(1:n, max(1, round(n * 0.05)))
      org["sub.stage", switch_idx] <- sample(1:7, length(switch_idx), replace = TRUE)
      sim$pop[[sp]]$org <- org
    }
    sim <- record_history(sim)
  }
  sim
}

future.events <- function(sim, nstep = 50, ...) step_sim_community(sim, nstep)
init.simulation <- function(count = c(200, 100), ...) make_sim_community(count[1], count[2])
\n\n')

## Programmatic Application Usage

Launch the interactive application natively in R:

```r
library(ewing)

hexmoveApp()
```
